permitted_methods: closed inventory, order, and cross-reference checks
exact integer, rational, and symbolic arithmetic
isolated pure calculations on declared synthetic individual states
complete Git tree, object, path, mode, status, and diff inspection

calling a transition, step, policy, runner, simulation, or trajectory
advancing model state even for one tick
parameter search or optimization over scientific outcomes
editing implementation, tests, fixtures, results, books, or PDFs

exact_arithmetic_rule: Every numeric mathematical example is evaluated as an integer, exact rational, or exact symbolic expression. Binary floating-point approximation is neither required nor accepted as the equality oracle.
